hero.tagline: An impressionist journey through light, philosophy & the cosmos

moon.label: I. The Moon
moon.heading: Selene's silver chariot
moon.intro: The Moon's gravitational pull creates the tides, but it also subtly affects the water within our bodies. We are, in a very real sense, lunar beings — creatures of the tide.

philosophy.label: II. The Waves
philosophy.heading: Ego, arrogance & the ocean of self
philosophy.intro: In the ocean of existence, arrogance is a wave that believes it is separate from the sea. It rises, it crashes, and it returns — never having been anything but water.

gita.label: III. The Battlefield
gita.heading: Wisdom from the Bhagavad Gita
gita.intro: Krishna describes three paths to liberation: Karma Yoga (selfless action), Jnana Yoga (knowledge), and Bhakti Yoga (devotion). The Gita does not prescribe one path — it honors all three as valid ways to the divine.

shiva.label: IV. The Dance
shiva.heading: Shiva & the cosmic rhythm
shiva.intro: In the Shiv Purana, Shiva is described as Nirguna — without attributes, without form, without beginning or end. He is not a god among gods but the ground of being itself, the silence between notes.

art.label: V. The Canvas
art.heading: Art, beauty & the act of seeing
art.intro: The flute is the oldest instrument — a hollow reed that sings when breath passes through it. It teaches that music is not made but revealed, not created but discovered in the space between silence and sound.
